step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram displays a serverless backend architecture for the Melco Club mobile applications. Two mobile app frontends (Melco Club Mobile App and WeChat Mobile App) interact with Amazon API Gateway. API Gateway routes requests to an AWS Lambda Authorizer for user authentication, and to backend Lambda Services for handling application functionality (e.g., hotel reservations, dining, payments). The Lambda backend interacts with Amazon DynamoDB for persistent data storage, AWS Secrets Manager for securing third-party API credentials, and external Third Party APIs.
